correctness.rationale: The leading Binet geometric mode cancels identically at z=1/A. For odd k, the next mode at z=-q/A^3 has exact positive amplitude C=(1+ps-qs^2)/(1+s); all higher modes are bounded by O(rho^k) relative. The remaining positive reciprocal tail has coefficient c(A-B)/(A-1) and A^-J scale. Ratio yields the phase law outside an exponentially narrow set; irrationality by quadratic conjugation plus equidistribution proves that set has density zero. The published strict two-sided bracket proves J exists and is lambda*k+O(1) for every positive odd k. Independent exact-Fraction finite checks matched the specified limitations.
